description: Connect Mara to witnessed gate load and leak outcomes without changing canonical Dam controls

replacements.old:
(<VERB? TURN>
	       <SETG DAM-MECH-BOLT-ATTEMPTED T>
	       <SET BEFORE ,GATES-OPEN>
	       <BOLT-F>
	       <COND (<NOT <EQUAL? .BEFORE ,GATES-OPEN>>
	              <SETG DAM-MECH-GATES-CYCLED T>)>
	       <RTRUE>)
replacements.new:
(<VERB? TURN>
	       <SETG DAM-MECH-BOLT-ATTEMPTED T>
	       <SET BEFORE ,GATES-OPEN>
	       <BOLT-F>
	       <COND (<NOT <EQUAL? .BEFORE ,GATES-OPEN>>
	              <SETG DAM-MECH-GATES-CYCLED T>)>
	       <MARA-DAM-AFTER-BOLT .BEFORE>
	       <RTRUE>)

replacements.old:
(<VERB? PUSH>
	       <SET BEFORE ,WATER-LEVEL>
	       <BUTTON-F>
	       <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,YELLOW-BUTTON>
	              <SETG DAM-MECH-INTERLOCK-SEEN T>)
	             (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,BROWN-BUTTON>
	              <SETG DAM-MECH-INTERLOCK-SEEN T>)
	             (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,RED-BUTTON>
	              <SETG DAM-MECH-LIGHTS-TOGGLED T>)
	             (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,BLUE-BUTTON>
	                   <EQUAL? .BEFORE 0>
	                   <G? ,WATER-LEVEL 0>>
	              <SETG DAM-MECH-LEAK-TRIGGERED T>)>
	       <RTRUE>)
replacements.new:
(<VERB? PUSH>
	       <SET BEFORE ,WATER-LEVEL>
	       <BUTTON-F>
	       <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,YELLOW-BUTTON>
	              <SETG DAM-MECH-INTERLOCK-SEEN T>)
	             (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,BROWN-BUTTON>
	              <SETG DAM-MECH-INTERLOCK-SEEN T>)
	             (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,RED-BUTTON>
	              <SETG DAM-MECH-LIGHTS-TOGGLED T>)
	             (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,BLUE-BUTTON>
	                   <EQUAL? .BEFORE 0>
	                   <G? ,WATER-LEVEL 0>>
	              <SETG DAM-MECH-LEAK-TRIGGERED T>)>
	       <MARA-DAM-AFTER-BUTTON ,PRSO .BEFORE>
	       <RTRUE>)
